L01.zh: 葱油拌面以葱香和咸鲜唤起上海日常饮食记忆。这款概念拿铁将葱香油与咸奶盖组合，用薄脆表现口感，不加入面条。
L01.en: Scallion oil noodles evoke everyday Shanghai food culture. This latte concept uses scallion oil, salted cream and a crisp garnish, without noodles.

L02.zh: 蝴蝶酥是上海西式糕点文化中熟悉的酥点。焦糖与蝴蝶酥碎将烘焙香气带入拿铁。
L02.en: Palmiers are familiar treats in Shanghai's Western-style bakeries. Caramel and palmier crumbs bring their baked aroma into a latte.

L03.zh: 酒酿圆子以米香和软糯口感为灵感。米乳咖啡、酒酿和迷你圆子构成甜品式咖啡，奶油表现云朵意象。
L03.en: Sweet fermented rice and rice balls inspire a dessert coffee with rice milk, fermented rice and mini rice balls, finished with cloud-like cream.

L04.zh: 鲜肉月饼的酥皮与咸鲜是创作出发点。以酥皮碎、海盐与白胡椒塑造风味意象，不添加肉馅。
L04.en: Flaky pastry and savory notes of pork mooncakes inspire this coffee. Pastry flakes, sea salt and white pepper evoke the idea; no meat filling is added.

L05.zh: 海派西式甜点提供栗子、奶油与蛋糕的组合灵感。栗子泥和蛋糕碎让咖啡呈现甜点口感。
L05.en: Shanghai's Western-style pastries inspire chestnut, cream and cake textures. Chestnut purée and cake crumbs turn coffee into a dessert experience.

L06.zh: 奶糖的甜香唤起城市零食记忆。奶糖风味糖浆、糯米纸与白巧克力形成脆皮咖啡构想。
L06.en: Milk candy recalls familiar city treats. Milk candy syrup, edible rice paper and white chocolate inspire a crisp-shell coffee.

L07.zh: 花椒的辛麻与黑巧的可可苦香碰撞，辛麻强度待测试。
L07.en: Sichuan pepper meets dark chocolate bitterness. The intensity needs testing.

L08.zh: 陈醋与山楂带来酸香，气泡水连接咖啡风味，使用非乳基底。
L08.en: Aged vinegar and hawthorn add tartness to sparkling coffee, using a non-dairy base.

L09.zh: 红腐乳的发酵咸香融入奶咖构想，乳化与盐度待测试。
L09.en: Red fermented tofu inspires savory cream coffee. Emulsion stability and salt balance need testing.

L10.zh: 酥油的乳脂香融入咖啡，以海盐点缀。
L10.en: Butter brings rich dairy notes to coffee, accented with sea salt.

L11.zh: 橄榄与咸柠的果香、咸酸口感结合气泡咖啡。
L11.en: Olive and salted lemon bring fruity, salty and tart notes to sparkling coffee.

L12.zh: 食用辣椒风味与黑巧相遇，微辣强度待测试。
L12.en: Chili flavor meets dark chocolate. A mild heat level needs testing.

text.zh: 云南咖啡是品牌多个基底的共同起点。
text.en: Yunnan coffee forms the starting point for many of our bases.

text.zh: 桂花香气连接江南甜食记忆与咖啡创作。
text.en: Osmanthus connects Jiangnan sweet flavors with coffee creativity.

text.zh: 以花椒的辛麻香气探索黑巧咖啡。
text.en: Pepper's aromatic tingling inspires dark chocolate coffee.

text.zh: 以陈醋酸香作为风味灵感，具体原料产地以采购标签为准。
text.en: Aged vinegar inspires tart notes. Ingredient origin depends on supplier labels.

text.zh: 咸柠与橄榄启发本品牌风味组合；不主张其为潮汕独有食材。
text.en: Salted lemon and olive inspire this brand's combination; neither is claimed to be exclusive to Chaoshan.
